We Are Forcepoint

The Only Thing Missing Is You

See All Jobs

#WeAreForcepoint

At Forcepoint, we celebrate what makes each of us unique while thriving on the collective energy that drives us forward. Our culture is built on inclusion, respect and a deep commitment to supporting diverse perspectives and passions. We’re people-centric, always listening, always evolving — and together, we’re shaping a workplace where everyone can reach their full potential.

See Us In Action on LinkedIn

Our vision is to safeguard data everywhere
—for people anywhere

Our Core Values

Customer-centric

We don’t simply respond to customer needs; we anticipate them. We listen with an open mind, embracing diverse inputs and collaborative perspectives to deliver the very best solutions that proactively meet - and exceed - their needs.

Simplicity-focused

We deliver from a foundation of simplicity in everything we do – from processes to the platform of solutions we provide our customers. We enable an optimal approach to security that feels like a breath of fresh air. Simple. Purposeful. Empowering. Security that opens opportunity.

Innovative

We are a force for positive change. United by our expertise, creativity and shared vision, we act with a sense of urgency to allow our customers to adapt to an ever-changing environment in near real-time. We are insatiable in our pursuit to build a safer future by solving the world’s toughest problems at scale.

Trustworthy and ethical

We are honest. Our words and actions are aligned. We act with integrity and the best intentions for our customers, partners and colleagues.

People-centric

We are committed to a people-centric culture and ecosystem—one that fosters inclusivity, diversity of thought, mutual respect and dignity and corporate responsibility—both at Forcepoint and in our communities.

Our position on AI in hiring, developing, and retaining talent

At Forcepoint, we believe AI is a force multiplier — not a replacement for human ingenuity. We actively encourage every team member to embrace AI tools as part of their daily workflow: to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, surface insights faster, and free up cognitive bandwidth for the work that requires distinctly human judgment, creativity, and collaboration.

We are building a workforce that is fluent in AI — one that continuously experiments, learns, and applies emerging tools to deliver greater impact for our customers and mission. People who bring curiosity, adaptability, and a proactive approach to AI-augmented work will thrive here.

Forcepoint’s Commitment to
 Work/Life Blend

Taking time to recharge isn’t just a nice-to-have — it’s essential for staying focused, energized and doing our best work.

At Forcepoint, we’re committed to supporting flexibility and balance. Alongside our global Hybrid Work Environment, our PTO offerings are designed to help you take the time you need — when you need it — so you can show up at your best, both personally and professionally.

Forcepoint’s Commitment to Community

We foster a culture of community within Team Forcepoint by volunteering with organizations that support health and human services, education and the environment. To do this, Forcepoint gives every full-time and part-time employee twenty (20) hours of paid volunteer time each calendar year. We make a massive, global impact!

Wherever you work with us, you’ll have access to world-class health, financial security and career growth programs.

  • Access to Forcepoint Employee Assistance Program (EAP) via TELUS Health, a confidential support service to help employees and their dependants solve a wide range of problems and challenges.

  • Wellness Programs. We offer wellness opportunities for personal, emotional and financial resources. Employees are invited to participate in seminars, podcasts and onsite vendor presentations.

  • Tuition Assistance Program. Forcepoint will reimburse up to USD$5,250 per annum for regular full-time employees. Employees must be with the company for at least 6 months and have completed their probation period.
